title: Brain (Obsidian Vault)
description: A local folder of markdown files acts as persistent memory for your agents. Fully compatible with Obsidian — open the same folder in Obsidian to read, edit, or graph your brain.
enableDescription: Turn on to let agents read and write notes in the vault.
vaultPathDescription: Where notes are stored on disk.
injectAgentMemoryDescription: When an agent has a note in agents/, its contents are prepended to the system prompt.
autoSummarizeDescription: After each chat, save a short summary under conversations/.
graphEmpty: No notes yet — once agents start writing to the vault, their links will appear here.
graphHint: Drag to pan · scroll to zoom · drag a node to reposition · double-click a node to reveal its file.
